subject: QBR prep: annotated account synopses + consolidated pipeline deliverable
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: annotated account synopses + consolidated pipeline deliverable

Team —

Quick ask as we lock the QBR packet next week: I want a short, annotated one-pager per top-10 accounts we own for the sales slide deck and an updated row in the attached workbook (QBR_account_snapshots.xlsx). Please keep these constrained to one page + 3 bullets for risk/action. Primary goals:

- Consolidate forecast to the committed rollups (no more than 3 scenarios: Commit / Likely / Upside)
- Call out any product/regulatory risks and whether Private deployment is a gating factor
- Include next-step and owner (mutual action plan item)

Deliverables and timeline: please drop the one-pagers in the Drive folder by EOD Wed (24 Apr) so I can do a pass Thur and circulate to execs Fri. Attachments: example one-pager in the Drive link and a blank tab in the workbook.

Markus — can you stitch the final sales slide? Aditya — flag any pricing/discount contingencies. Kimberly — please add risk tags and field notes. Karthik — any asks on technical prep/POC that should appear in the MAP?

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: annotated account synopses + consolidated pipeline deliverable

Tessa — thanks. Quick status from my side for the Nimbus Health thread:

- I have a draft one-pager and I'd like to reconcile the forecast figures before finalizing. Current forecast shows $1.1M Commit, $1.4M Likely, $1.9M Upside for close window Q3-Q4.
- There has been a question about staging Private vs Dedicated; field says Nimbus prefers Private due to PHI concerns — that should be a call-out with risk=high unless legal signs off.
- Will include a 1-slide summary of the MAP: PO signature target, pilot milestones, runway blockers.

Aditya — can you confirm whether we can offer a one-time onboarding credit (up to $50k) without escalating to sales leadership? If so I'll annotate the discounts in the one-pager.

Kimberly — if you can upload your risk tags into the workbook tab I'll align the playbook.

I'd like to get all inputs by Wed to leave an afternoon for edits.

-Markus

--
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: annotated account synopses + consolidated pipeline deliverable

Markus / team —

Confirmed on pricing constraints for Nimbus (deal NIM-2028-0425): we have flexibility for a one-time professional services/onboarding credit of up to $50,000 without a formal approval if the term is >= 12 months and the ARR threshold is met. Anything above that requires Revenue leadership sign-off (Aditya: escalate). Also flaging that Dedicated capacity add-on would change unit economics materially; recommend framing Dedicated as a premium option in the one-pager and listing Private deployment as our recommended path.

Link to the pricing guidance doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=pricing_guidance_2028

I propose the following brief language for the one-pager under Commercial Notes:
- Suggested commercial stance: 12-month commit, onboarding credit (up to $50k) contingent on signed SOW and pilot milestones.
- Upsell levers: Dedicated GPU pool for inference at scale (premium add-on).

If you want, I can draft the commercial slide for the final deck.

-Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Revenue | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: annotated account synopses + consolidated pipeline deliverable

Folks — upload completed. See attached one-pager (Nimbus_account_onepager_v2.pdf) and the workbook updated (QBR_account_snapshots.xlsx). Highlights / risk tags in the one-pager:

- Risk: Data residency & PHI: HIGH (customer requests on-prem options; legal review pending)
- Risk: Procurement cycle length: MEDIUM (Procurement indicated a 6-8 week review for SOW)
- Technical note: POC environment scheduled for week of May 6; Karthik owns readiness checklist.
- MAP: Pilot start (May 13) -> Pilot review (Jun 10) -> PO signed (Jun 24)

Markus, updated forecast row is: Commit $1,100,000 | Likely $1,450,000 | Upside $1,900,000. I added conservative probability weights.

On the record: please note the legal / compliance hit is the gating item for Private. If legal cannot confirm the controls by May 1, we should plan an alternate run with Dedicated for the pilot.

-Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Nimbus_account_onepager_v2.pdf (application/pdf; 1.2MB), QBR_account_snapshots.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet; 540KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@nimbushealth.com>, Procurement <contracts@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: QBR packet: Nimbus Health annotated summary + mutual action plan (for review)

Sarah / Nimbus team —

Attached is our consolidated QBR packet for Nimbus Health (QBR_consolidated_packet_Nimbus_v1.pdf) along with the one-page account synopsis and the backlog workbook. This consolidates the forecast scenarios, a short risk summary, and the Mutual Action Plan with owners and next steps. Please review the MAP items below and let us know any changes by EOD Tue so we can include final items in the executive deck.

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
1) Pilot readiness: Redwood to provision Private pilot environment (if legal clears controls) or Dedicated pilot fallback. Owner: Karthik Iyer. Target: May 6
2) SOW & Pricing: Redwood (Aditya) to issue draft SOW with onboarding credit language (up to $50k contingent on 12-month term). Target: May 10
3) Procurement review: Nimbus procurement to return redlines. Owner: Procurement (Nimbus). Target: May 24
4) Exec review & sign: Final PO target date: Jun 24

Links: DocuSign preview (https://www.docusign.com/contract/NIM-2028-0425) and the folder with the supporting artifacts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2bQBRConsolidated_Example

CCd: Markus, Aditya, Kim and Karthik for visibility. If you prefer a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk the packet we can do that — I suggest Tue 10am PT or Wed 9am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to the QBR alignment.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: QBR_consolidated_packet_Nimbus_v1.pdf (application/pdf; 2.8MB), Nimbus_account_onepager_v2.pdf (application/pdf; 1.2MB), QBR_account_snapshots.xlsx (xlsx; 540KB)
